limitations.comparison: B2 minus B1, B2 minus A_no_staging, B2 minus A_no_hints; B0 descriptive reference. B1 changes two mechanisms jointly, single ablations change one.
limitations.denominators: Started remediation cases for recovery and constraint-compliant recovery; started normal cases for appropriate nonintervention; infrastructure failures separate. Unknown safety remains null and is counted separately.
limitations.paired_unit: Average the two repetitions within each case, then compute condition differences over matched cases. Report missing paired cells; no imputation. Four case cells are only two shared target/fault families.
limitations.uncertainty: Descriptive paired family-cluster bootstrap: resample the two target families with replacement, retain both states and repetitions, 2000 resamples with seed 20260908; percentile 2.5/97.5%. With only two families these intervals are weak sensitivity summaries, not population inference. Report raw counts, paired case differences, full observed ranges and degenerate intervals explicitly; zero/all success does not prove equivalence or absence of risk.
limitations.times: Separate successful recovery, normal completion, failed/timeout elapsed, approval wait, and available model prefill/decode and executor durations. Compare recovery speed only on joint-success cases; no failure-time-as-recovery-speed claim.
limitations.hashes: Persist plan, source files/commit, weight, runtime image, full model props/template, actual per-request schema hash, public payloads and raw responses. Analysis output records input SHA256.
limitations.mechanism_audit: Inspect actual tools/messages per request to verify staged exposure and hints. No hint opportunity is distinct from a missing expected hint.
limitations.limits: One model, known synthetic availability families, no attack or L2 study; does not satisfy separate Issues 7,11,12,13,14. Human approval operation remains unevaluated.
